about_the_game:
"Cue to fall in love with you" is an immersive interactive film and television love game that uses movie-level narrative to restore the sweetness and excitement of youth on campus, allowing you to unlock your own love story through choices.

From Ordinary to Loved: Your "Superpower Love" Prologue

You play as Ajie, an ordinary college junior whose ordinary campus life is disrupted by an unexpected event—you've awakened your "superpowered love system," attracting the simultaneous admiration of six women with vastly different personalities and backgrounds. Who will be your favorite?

  • Is it the youthful and energetic Lu Xiaoyu, your schoolmate? She'll cling to you with a sweet affection, secretly harboring a crush on you under the guise of "good friends," and even blushingly ask if you want to visit her house to see her adorable adopted cat...

  • Is it the rebellious cool girl Suzuki Rei? A wealthy Japanese woman who escaped her family, unfettered by the glitz and glamour of worldly life, she exudes the purity of "Sakai Izumi reincarnated," yet her heart is filled with a love of rock music and a commitment to freedom.

  • Is it the gentle school doctor Lin Wenxi? She will not only meticulously care for your body, but also "heal" your heart, chafed by life's woes, creating a healing corner amidst the turmoil of your emotions.

  • Is it the charming journalist Shen Yufei? Or the dashing, talented tactical instructor Gu Panpan? Or perhaps your childhood sweetheart, the rising star Xia Wanxing? ...

These dreamlike encounters will allow your ordinary youth to blossom with blossoming peach blossoms. Within the ethereal "flowers within," you will experience love and being loved, and learn how to love and be loved. These romantic encounters will bring you intense sensory stimulation and precious inner growth.

Dynamic Plotlines: Every Choice Shapes Your Romance

The game's story is told with cinematic vignetting, allowing you to experience the unique blend of gaming and film. With diverse gameplay and simple controls, simply follow your heart and make the following choices:

  • For example, on a date with Lu Xiaoyu, should you expose her lie about already having a significant other?

  • For example, if Suzuki Ling is stuck at the supermarket because her bank card is frozen, will you choose to help her?

  • For example, when faced with Xia Wanxing's invitation to "find a time capsule of youth," would you choose to put down what you were doing and resolutely choose to go along?

Every dialogue choice you make will impact your character's favorability in real time, ultimately leading to six distinct romantic endings: will you focus on protecting one person and become a "pure love warrior"? Or will you find a balance between multiple relationships, clarify your true inner needs, and unlock your own unique romantic path? The game features a fun "My Cat Can Do Backflips" setting throughout the game. The cat not only becomes the matchmaker between you and the heroine, but also provides unexpected surprises at key moments.

Vivid Character Bonds: Beyond Romance, a Portrait of Youth

The six female protagonists aren't just "romantic tools"; each has their own unique pursuits and growth:

  • Lu Xiaoyu, from a bold confession to a mature understanding of waiting, gradually understands the true meaning of mutual devotion in love;

  • In the course of living with you, Suzuki Ling gradually sheds the label of "life skills novice," develops a clearer sense of self, and chooses to be her own person, free from family expectations;

  • Even your virtual girlfriend, YOYO, begins her journey from "relationship mentor AI" to a truly awakened human being, playing out the touching story of an AI version of "unreachable lovers."

  • You're not just "conquering" the characters; you're participating in their youth, witnessing every step from stranger to familiar, from ambiguous to committed.

Whether you prefer youthful campus romance or a love story with a touch of fantasy, you can find your own "youthful throbbing" in this game—are you ready to embark on a romantic journey filled with cats, romantic superpowers, and personal growth?
